about_the_game:
Aztec cuisine was not only for sustenance or survival. It was a vital part of their religion, culture as well as society and still has an impact on present food creations. This cookbook contains 25 recipes to bring traditional Aztec and Mexican food to your home. The appetizers, main courses and deserts can be easily recreated in your own kitchen and take you and your taste buds on a culinary journey to Central America. Enhanced by beautiful pictures of the finished dishes, the recipes in this cookbook will become your go-to inspiration from finger foods to wholesome soul food and beyond.

IMPORTANT INFO: After the "installation", the book will be saved as a PDF in your game folder. You can find them in the game folder of Steam, which can be found in a standard installation under "Steam\steamapps\common\Aztecs The Last Sun".

Please note: The official cook book for Aztecs: The Last Sun is only available in English and German.
